about:
ESS Metron Inc is based in Denver, Colorado. The company has over 60 years of experience in the design and manufacture of electrical power distribution equipment, though a specific founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and manufactures low-voltage and medium-voltage switchgear, including 5 kV–38 kV metal‑enclosed load interrupter switchgear, as well as integrated power distribution centers, custom control products, modular control buildings, and skid‑mounted power distribution substations. It offers standard product designs that can be configured to customer requirements, supported by in‑house design and engineering resources. No facility size, headcount, or production volume figures are provided.

ESS Metron serves data centers with UL‑listed low‑ and medium‑voltage switchgear, controls for power throw‑over schemes, and power distribution centers for UPS and critical power distribution. The company also mentions SCADA and building management system integration. Other industries are not specified in the available sources.

The company emphasizes configurable standard designs, engineering capabilities for custom solutions, and what it describes as best‑in‑industry lead times.
